# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes are applied on the latest `main` branch of Wisp.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please **do not** open a public GitHub issue for security problems.

Email the maintainer privately with:

- A short description of the issue
- Steps to reproduce
- Impact (e.g. XSS, path traversal, SQL injection)
- Your preferred credit name (optional)

We will acknowledge the report and work on a fix as quickly as practical. Thank you for helping keep Wisp users safe.
